Depression.note: Long first-person answers, like the training posts. Some probability tends to leak into Suicidal.

items.question: How have you been feeling emotionally over the past two weeks?
items.answer: I have been feeling empty and numb for months now. I wake up and feel nothing, I just go through the motions and I do not know why I even bother. Nothing feels worth it anymore.

items.question: What do you do in your free time, and do you still enjoy it?
items.answer: I used to love playing guitar and going out with friends but I do not enjoy anything anymore. I just lie in bed all day scrolling my phone and feeling like a waste of space.

items.question: How have your sleep and energy levels been?
items.answer: I am exhausted all the time but I cannot sleep properly. Some days I sleep twelve hours and still feel tired, other days I lie awake until 5am. I have no energy to do anything.

items.question: How do you feel about yourself lately?
items.answer: I hate myself. I feel like a failure and a burden to everyone around me. I do not think I have ever done anything right and I feel worthless.

items.question: How are things with your friends and family?
items.answer: I have been pushing everyone away. I feel so lonely even when people are around me but I do not want to talk to anybody. I cannot be bothered to reply to messages anymore.

items.question: How do you feel about the future?
items.answer: I do not see things getting better. I have been depressed for years and I feel like I will always be stuck like this. I cannot picture a future where I am actually happy.

Anxiety.note: The Anxiety class seems heavy on health anxiety (symptoms, doctors, panic attacks), so these answers lean on that.

items.question: How often do you feel nervous or on edge, and what is it like?
items.answer: Pretty much every day. My heart starts racing out of nowhere and I get this tight feeling in my chest. I can’t stop thinking something is wrong and it makes me panic.

items.question: What do you worry about the most?
items.answer: Everything, honestly. I worry about my health, I keep googling symptoms and convincing myself I have something serious. Every little pain turns into a cancer scare in my head.

items.question: How does anxiety affect your sleep?
items.answer: I lie awake at night with my heart pounding and my mind racing, scared that something is wrong with me. I get so anxious thinking about every symptom that I end up panicking until morning.

items.question: What physical sensations do you notice when you are anxious?
items.answer: I get dizzy and shaky, my stomach is in knots and sometimes I feel like I can’t breathe. Last week I went to the ER because I thought it was a heart attack but the doctor said it was a panic attack.

items.question: Do you avoid any situations because of your anxiety?
items.answer: Yes, I avoid anything that sets off my anxiety. I’m scared of having a panic attack in public so I stay home, and even a phone call makes my heart race and my hands shake.

items.question: Are you able to relax?
items.answer: No, I can’t relax at all. I’m constantly restless and on edge, always waiting for something bad to happen. Even when everything is fine I feel this sense of dread.

Stress.note: The Stress class seems to lean on the literal word 'stress' and on work, school and deadlines, so these answers use those.

items.question: What is your main source of stress right now?
items.answer: Work, mostly. I have three deadlines this week and my boss keeps adding more tasks. I feel so stressed and overwhelmed, I don’t know how I’m going to get it all done.

items.question: How are you coping with the stress?
items.answer: Honestly not well. I’ve been trying to manage my stress with exercise and meditation but I’m still stressed out all the time. Any tips on how to deal with it?

items.question: Has stress affected you physically?
items.answer: I get constant headaches and tension in my neck and shoulders. I’m grinding my teeth at night and my stomach is upset every morning before work.

items.question: How do you feel about your workload and your time?
items.answer: There aren’t enough hours in the day. Between school, my part-time job and family stuff I never get a break and I feel like I’m going to burn out.

items.question: How have stress levels affected your mood with other people?
items.answer: The stress is making me short tempered with everyone. I’m so stressed from work and deadlines that the littlest thing sets me off, and then I feel guilty about it.

items.question: Are you able to switch off and take time for yourself?
items.answer: I can’t switch off. Even on weekends I’m thinking about my to do list and my emails. I feel like I never get a break from the pressure.

items.question: How have you been feeling lately?
items.answer: Honestly pretty good. Work has been busy but manageable, and I have been making time to see friends on weekends, which helps me recharge.

items.question: How have you been sleeping?
items.answer: Mostly well. I go to bed around eleven and wake up rested, with the odd bad night when I have had too much coffee.

items.question: How do you feel about the future?
items.answer: Hopeful. There is a lot I want to do this year, like learning to cook properly and planning a trip with my sister.
